object of utterance; the foundational mantra
gerund indicating prior action leading to the main act
object of the main verb; the deity's proximity

items.question: By what act is the deity's presence ritually established after invocation?
premises: The practitioner has already performed the verbal invocation of presence.
The root mantra is designated for utterance in this rite.
Uttering the root mantra serves to effect the deity's presence.
items.inference: The ritual establishment of presence is completed by uttering the root mantra.
items.plain_english: Having uttered the root mantra, one should establish the deity's presence.
